why: No major reviewer or authority addresses triple-screen extenders for the M3 MacBook Pro: the two famous names (TechRadar, Tom's Guide) are about desktop monitors and generic M6 accessories. Everything else is brand store pages (Aura x4, FOPO), retailer listings (Best Buy, Mavigadget x2) repeating unverified spec claims, and a 404. A page that tests several extenders on an M3 MacBook Pro, explains the DisplayLink vs Alt Mode display-limit issue, and gives a direct pick with prices would stand out.
